trust.title: Trust this publisher key?

trust.explain: Compare the fingerprint with one the publisher gave you over another channel. Once trusted, the key is pinned: updates signed by a different key are refused.

permissions.subtitle: {{name}} asks for these permissions
permissions.hint: Unchecked requests are denied. You can change grants later in Plugins.

plugins.safeModeHint: While on, no plugin code is loaded or run: tools, widgets and integrations from plugins are unavailable until you turn it off. Persists across restarts.

plugins.safeModeOn: Safe mode on: plugin code will not run.
plugins.killAllHint: Emergency stop: interrupts every running plugin call and moves every plugin to Killed. Re-enable them one by one afterwards.
plugins.killConfirmText: Every running plugin call is interrupted and every plugin is stopped. Nothing is uninstalled; you can enable plugins again later.
plugins.emptyHint: Install a signed .orkp package from a file or from Browse.
plugins.uninstallConfirmText: The plugin, its grants and its stored data are removed. Dashboard widgets from it stop rendering.
